mentions.name: Timelocked
mentions.description: This local app encrypts any file or message but delays decryption, letting users timelock a BIP39 passphrase for a duration of their choice. It is designed to deter $5-wrench-style coercion attacks targeting cryptocurrency holders by delaying access to personal funds without relying on third parties or multisig, and can also support self-managed inheritance and limiting digital addictions.
mentions.problem: Cryptocurrency-related home invasions ('"$5 wrench attacks"') where attackers coerce victims into surrendering funds; users need a way to delay access to personal funds without third parties or multisig.
mentions.audience: Individuals securing personal cryptocurrency funds and digital assets
mentions.source_excerpt: I've just published Timelocked (https://github.com/Caltanjun/timelocked), a local app that encrypts any file or message but delays decryption.
